title: Implement Setup preview and non-vacuous protection status
goal: Report exact local setup readiness and protection proof without applying Target or remote changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Setup preview reports ordered typed steps and marks Target, composition and remote apply unavailable.
Protected requires every accepted V4-AD-040 proof and cannot follow from a no-op Profile or local pass.
Unavailable CI enforcement is explicit and forces protected false rather than being inferred from workflow text.
Preview identity changes on authoritative input drift and stale confirmation is rejected.
risks: A local pass or workflow file could be misreported as enforced protection.
decisions: Fail closed unless every protection component has positive exact proof.
